_comment: Per-language clause text that may precede an organization name before a legal-form suffix. `phrases` are trimmed unconditionally when found inside an over-captured legal-form span. `directPrefixes` are trimmed only when the text before the prefix already looks like prose, so company names such as `Stand By Me LLC` are preserved. `partyLabelArticles` are permitted only before a scoped party role in a labelled subject clause. Every legal-role language has reviewed articles or a `partyLabelArticleOmission` rationale.

fr.partyLabelArticleOmission: French gender, number, and elision require reviewed exact role phrases; broad article-role products are disabled.

it.partyLabelArticleOmission: Italian gender, number, and elision require reviewed exact role phrases; broad article-role products are disabled.

pt-br.partyLabelArticleOmission: Brazilian Portuguese gender and number agreement require reviewed exact role phrases; broad article-role products are disabled.
